    print(tag,"level",current_frame.level,"step",current_frame.step,"timer",tb,"Y",ys)
snap("before")
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':60,'col':50}])
snap("after")
print("done",r.get('done'),"gameover",r.get('game_over'),"lvl",r.get('level_completed'),"changed",r.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
